title: Nifty Gap Up Pattern 🔥 2021 Jaisa Rally Phir Se?
description:
Nifty gap up pattern explained in Hindi — aaj ki gap-up candle ke baad kal Nifty kya karega?

Nifty ne aaj ek GAP-UP candle banayi — Bollinger band ke upar close, aur momentum indicator zero ke upar. Chirag Rathod ka observation: ye pattern akela nahi aata — 3 ya 5 gap-ups ke set mein aata hai. Isliye kal ke liye view bullish hai.

📌 August 2021 mein bilkul yahi pattern bana tha — gap-up, gap-up, gap-up — aur Nifty seedha 18,600 tak gaya. Pattern repeat hota hai, bas pehchanna aana chahiye.
